name: firmory
description: Search, download, capture, and share reusable Skills with your team and AI agents

interface.shortDescription: Search, capture, and share reusable AI Skills
interface.longDescription:
Search Skills across your workspace and Firmory's public Discover catalog, inspect their steps and files, download complete Skill packages locally, or run them directly in your conversation.

Turn how you work into a reusable Skill as you chat: Firmory saves steps, supporting files, lessons learned, and context with inline receipts, one-click undo, and pause controls. Share any Skill safely with an interactive confirmation card that reviews public parts, keeps memory private unless switched on, hides personal or company names, and prepares ready-to-post links.
defaultPrompt: Search Firmory for a skill I can use, view its contents, or download it
Turn how I do this task into a reusable Firmory skill
Show me the skills, projects, and files available in my workspace
